## Source
.design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md — Open Questions Q1-Q6.

## Decisions required (provisional in #153)
- Q1 batch vs realtime priority: A (batch first; provisional)
- Q2 FIDO2 vs PKCS#11: C (both; PKCS#11 default; provisional)
- Q3 PIN UX: A for PKCS#11 (start-cached in secrecy) + D for FIDO2 (touch)
- Q4 batch touch policy: A (touch-per-sign; provisional)
- Q5 N-of-M quorum: A (single-token v2; quorum is its own future design)
- Q6 daemon transport: A (gRPC over TLS-mutual-auth; reuses tonic from ML epic)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Six decisions recorded as `--kind decision` comments.

- Blocks #164 (Q1 + Q2 shape what PR 1 builds first).
